steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Food provenance means knowing where food comes from — how, where, and by whom it was produced, processed, and transported. | Key Fact: Intensive farming maximises yield using fertilisers, pesticides, antibiotics, and high-density housing; it produces cheap food but raises welfare and environmental concerns. | Key Fact: Organic farming avoids artificial chemicals, uses crop rotation and natural fertilisers, and provides higher animal welfare; it is more expensive and yields are lower. | Key Fact: Free-range and barn-raised systems give animals more space and outdoor access compared to intensive caged systems; UK and EU law defines minimum standards.
